articles.title: Top Chinese general investigated for corruption amid escalation of military purge
articles.summary: China's top general is under corruption investigation, marking a significant escalation in President Xi Jinping's ongoing purge of the military leadership. This widespread crackdown aims to consolidate Xi's sole operational command over the People's Liberation Army. This development highlights internal power dynamics affecting a major global military, influencing China's strategic posture and defense effectiveness.

articles.title: Drones, long-range weapons, Op Sindoor tableau in focus at Republic Day parade
articles.summary: The upcoming 77th Republic Day parade will prominently feature India's advanced defence capabilities. Highlights include a range of drones, loitering munitions, and long-range weapons, demonstrating technological prowess. A special tableau depicting 'Operation Sindoor' will also be showcased, underscoring significant national defence achievements. This display reinforces India's commitment to modernizing its armed forces.

articles.title: Pro tem extension may add 1,200 MSMEs to telecom gear space
articles.summary: India is set to boost its domestic telecom equipment manufacturing sector, with the government extending its Pro Tem Certification Scheme. This move will drastically reduce certification costs, incentivizing the establishment of 800-1,200 new micro and small enterprises. This initiative aims to foster indigenous production and innovation, strengthening India's self-reliance in the critical telecom equipment space.

articles.title: In a first for India, Army Rowing Node Best Programme of the Year award of World Rowing
articles.summary: The Army Rowing Node (ARN) at the College of Military Engineering (CME), Pune, has received the 'Best Rowing Programme of the Year' award from World Rowing, the international governing body. This prestigious recognition underscores the Indian Army's commitment to sports excellence, infrastructure development, and nurturing high-calibre athletes, demonstrating the discipline and comprehensive capabilities valued in service life.

articles.title: Lieutenant Governor’s Message on Eve of Republic Day
articles.summary: Lieutenant Governor Shri Manoj Sinha issued a message on the eve of the 77th Republic Day, marking the auspicious and momentous occasion for the nation. Although the specific contents are not detailed, his address likely emphasized national pride, achievements, unity, and constitutional values, encouraging citizens to uphold democratic principles and work towards India's progress on this significant day.

articles.title: From shy Lucknow boy to first Indian astronaut on ISS - the trailblazing flight of Shubhanshu Shukla
articles.summary: IAF fighter pilot Shubhanshu Shukla is poised to script history, following Rakesh Sharma as an Indian venturing into space. Born in Lucknow, Shukla will represent the tricolour in an upcoming mission, highlighting India's growing prowess in space exploration. This achievement underscores the crucial role of the Indian Air Force in national scientific endeavours and inspires SSB aspirants.

articles.title: Newly-raised Bhairav Battalion to be centrepiece of Republic Day Parade in Kolkata
articles.summary: The newly-raised 6th Bhairav Battalion will be a major highlight at Kolkata's Republic Day Parade on Red Road, touted as India's second-biggest military display. Its participation showcases the continuous strengthening and modernization of our armed forces. For SSB aspirants, this event signifies national pride and the integration of new defence units into grand national celebrations, inspiring future military leadership.
